app_fee.value: The application fee is $30 (the Graduate School lists it as 30.00USD).

fee_waiver.value: The Graduate School cannot waive the application fee, except narrow exceptions for FAMU Feeder, McNair and McKnight Scholars; there is no international-only waiver.
fee_waiver.quote: the Office of Graduate Admissions is unable to waive the application fee payment for graduate applicants | Exceptions may exist for applicants that have completed the FAMU Feeder program, McNair Scholars, or McKnight Scholars

also.quote: the Graduate School does not offer application waivers under any circumstances

gre_general.value: The GRE is required for doctoral applicants; some programs offer a waiver, so check the program record.
gre_general.quote: Official test results are required from a nationally standardized graduate admission test | Some programs offer an option to waive the GRE requirement

toefl_min.value: Internet TOEFL 4.0 on the new scale for tests taken on or after 21 January 2026 (80 for older tests). Some departments set higher minimums.
toefl_min.quote: Internet based TOEFL (IBTOEFL): 80 (if taken before January 21, 2026) or 4.0 (if taken on or after January 21, 2026)

ielts_min.quote: International English Language Testing System (Academic IELTS): 6.5

english_waiver.value: The English test is waived only for a BA or higher from the US or an English-speaking country. The page does not say whether an English-medium Indian degree counts, and India is not on its published exempt-country list.

notes: Doctoral pages checked: Graduate School list and admissions pages (Graduate School footer dated 2024). Department PhD list: 'Doctoral Degree Programs' page. Undated day-and-month deadlines are Not stated.
